about: WoW Forever's release phases, in release order. The client already carries content the game has not opened yet; what a phase lists (and everything only it gives: loot, quests, recipes) shows as Later instead of missing until the phase opens. opens: the date it opens (YYYY-MM-DD), or null while Blizzard has not announced one. maps: instances by English name or map id. npcs, objects, quests, items, spells: ids (npcs also by English name). See docs/PHASES.md.

phases.name: First raids
phases.source: Blizzard's raid preview: Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit and Onyxia's Lair open five weeks after launch. Map 3002: a raid the client keeps encrypted (no Map row, two raid encounters), so one of the two new raids

phases.name: Later dungeons
phases.source: In the client but not among the 9 new launch dungeons; Blizzard plans two more dungeons per 2027 update

phases.name: Later raids
phases.source: In the client, no date announced. Quests: the Thunderfury (Rise, Thunderfury!) and Atiesh chains, taken and handed in outside the raids their pieces drop in

phases.name: Not out yet
phases.source: Spells in the client that nothing teaches on live WoW Forever: Wowhead's Forever pages list no trainer, quest, item, talent or perk for them, and no client spell teaches them (2026-11-18): Teleport: Dalaran, Lacerate rank 4, Voice of Truth, Improved Seal of Fury. Items that teach a spell (recipes, mounts, pets) and that nothing hands out on live WoW Forever (2026-11-18): Wowhead's Forever list pages name no source for them (no drop, vendor, quest, craft or container) or do not list them at all: holiday items whose holiday has not come round since launch (Lunar Festival rockets and lanterns, Love is in the Air, Hallow's End), patterns and formulas nobody has found yet, mount colours the newest build no longer carries, Season of Discovery formulas

phases.name: Promotions
phases.source: Items live WoW Forever gives only outside the game (2026-11-18): Wowhead's Forever pages name a promotion as their only source (trading card loot: Riding Turtle, White Tiger Cub, Hippogryph Hatchling; the Lashling buds, Tiny Bronze Whelpling), or the server's only quests for them have no giver because the game hands them out by code (collector's edition 'Welcome!' pets 13582-13584, iCoke voucher pets 22780, 22781)
